notes.title: Free4Ever
notes.content:
[b]Date to become free: 06/10/2021[/b] (10/06/2021 para os BR)

Thanks to everyone who played my game, I did it with great affection and I know it wasn't perfect, but the release showed me how much the community can support even the smallest developers

my thanks is leaving the game free, for those who bought it I hope you understand... I did it because I noticed several design errors within the game and I want to create something better

I'm working on a new game, following all the tips, criticisms, advice, help I've received since I launched "Fortuito: Lost History". keep an eye out! ːsteammockingː

[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCpHYsM4oCgvFpcZhkMLUKsw]MY YOUTUBE CHANNEL[/url]

VLW GALERA, TMJ

notes.title: First update - thanks for the support!
notes.content:
Hello, I would like to thank everyone who evaluated the game or who commented about it, all criticisms are welcome, here is the first update for the game!

-New Difficulty mode (Original and Easy)
-bug fixes
-some rework on game desing, like position of puzzle objetcs, some new event, new sounds, now you can see the ammo in screen

thanks for the support! :D
